What do we need there?"},{"id":"M1:T42","text":"So all communication should be built on standard communication protocols, the kind where retry procedures are part of the protocol itself. Next, software constraints. What do we need from the software packages?"},{"id":"M1:T48","text":"Every Gemini subsystem package should ship with two things as part of the software. First, a simulator module that goes into the virtual telescope, that's covered under design constraints below. Second, user interface modules for whatever user interface environments that subsystem will run in. The interfaces those UI modules need are described in Section 3.3, on page 3-6."},{"id":"M1:T49","text":"And all Gemini software has to be fully documented.
